notes.title: First Game Update of 2020!
notes.notes:
A new year has begun! 2020 is here and we are working hard to expand and improve Project Plainsight. 

Here are the bug fixes and improvements we have made to kick off the new year.

[list]
[*] Added End of match report.
[*] Improved Movement speed of both Playable Characters.
[*] Searchable file cabinets now move the Mannequin so the player will no longer get stuck.
[*] Extended the duration of the "How to Play" starting prompt. 
[*] Fixed Security Guard animation error that caused the Guard to continue moving even if the player stopped. 
[*] Reduced Searchable Objects count from 42 to 38.
[*] Added Clarifying Markers for all 3 of the Exits.
[*] Fixed Key Objects UI icons to make it more clear when they are found.
[*] Improved detection of Searchable Objects for Mannequin player. 
[*] Fixed bug where the exit prompt didn’t work. 
[/list]

Thank you all for your valuable feedback! We look forward to what this year will bring and hope that you all continue giving us feedback and have fun hiding in Plainsight ;)
